# trace-to-sequence

> Convert OTLP JSON or simple span JSON traces into Mermaid sequence diagrams of calls and returns between services, with safe label escaping Python package `trysac-trace-to-sequence`, import name `trace_to_sequence`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
